Holder C07196-K2|205|190 has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases, and the flagged in-person product W transaction aligns with the card's dominant baseline where 79 of 98 baseline transactions were in-person product W purchases.
The flagged transaction amount of $1,336.84 is higher than the holder anchor's single prior transaction of $103.43 on the same day (transaction 3660324), representing an elevated purchase amount.

Region 205 is an established region for card C07196-K2 with 7 historical transactions including a $1,023.18 in-person purchase (transaction 3631424) on 2017-01-06, and region 205 shows zero high-scoring transactions across 64 cards in the 7-day window (lift 0.0).

Card C07196-K2 belongs to community 119537790 with a 5.0 lift vs base rate (2 of 4 cards with confirmed fraud), although the card itself is not in any device ring (ring_id -1) and the flagged transaction was in-person without device telemetry.

Prior closed case CC-5401 on card C07196-K2 was a model alert on a large $1,502.41 transaction that was cleared as legitimate cardholder activity, unlike earlier October 2016 fraud cases CC-4781 and CC-4581 which involved customer-reported out-of-region fraud.

case.summary: Transaction 3631383 for $1,336.84 on card C07196-K2 was flagged by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.66. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.006 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.0063. The in-person transaction in region 205 aligns with the cardholder's established baseline pattern of in-person product W purchases and prior regional spending. Furthermore, the card is not linked to any device fraud ring, and prior high-value model alert CC-5401 was cleared as legitimate. The alert is determined to be a false alarm, and the case is closed as legitimate activity.
